issue.title: Refine chat composition header and composer
issue.description:
Refine the chat conversation gallery composition into a cleaner, more minimal conversation card.

Owner direction:

* Remove the current card title/subtitle treatment.
* Use a simple contact header at the top with:
  * one avatar;
  * contact name only;
  * no email address.
* Do not repeat avatars beside individual message bubbles.

Conversation cleanup:

* Remove the extra duplicated incoming message bubble currently reading "Headings sit at 600 now." or equivalent.
* Remove delivery/read metadata such as:
  * "Read 09:43"
  * "Delivered 09:46"
* Keep a concise set of incoming and outgoing message bubbles.
* Preserve left/right alignment for sender/receiver messages.

Composer:

* Add a simple message composer at the bottom of the card.
* Placeholder text:
  "Type your message..."
* Add an icon-only send button aligned to the far right inside the composer.
* Prefer existing shadcn Input/Button/Icon primitives where appropriate.
* The send affordance may have hover/focus/pressed states, but it does not need to append a new message.
* Sending must not materially change card height or gallery geometry.

Header example direction:

* Avatar + contact name only.
* No subtitle, email, status text, or extra metadata unless source inspection shows a minimal accessibility need.

Design-system constraints:

* Continue using the official shadcn Message/Bubble resources already introduced by <issue id="57a71107-55c1-4878-a998-b436f6ecab7f" href="https://linear.app/emman-systems/issue/PUI-88/replace-this-week-with-a-chat-conversation-composition">PUI-88</issue>.
* Do not invent a second chat-message architecture.
* Keep styling driven by Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Preserve light/dark mode.
* Use Heading / Body / Mono roles appropriately.
* Avoid arbitrary raw colors when semantic tokens exist.

Interaction boundaries:

* Keep the card primarily as a visual showcase.
* No dynamic message insertion.
* No streaming.
* No expanding threads.
* No drawers or workflow-heavy chat logic.
* Preserve stable outer geometry.

Accessibility:

* Preserve keyboard/focus behavior.
* Ensure the composer has an accessible input label/name.
* Ensure the icon-only send button has an accessible name.
* Preserve sensible reading order for header, messages, and composer.

Acceptance:

* Chat card header shows a single avatar and contact name only.
* No email is shown.
* No avatars appear beside individual messages.
* No title/subtitle remains above the contact header.
* The extra "Headings sit at 600 now." message is removed.
* Read/Delivered metadata is removed.
* Incoming/outgoing bubbles remain visually clear.
* A bottom composer shows "Type your message..." with an icon-only send button on the far right.
* Composer interaction does not append content or change card height.
* Light/dark/theme-token responsiveness remains intact.
* No overflow, keyboard, focus, accessibility, or responsive regression.
